items.description: The Chobe River is a tributary of the Zambezi, known for its large elephant herds and abundant wildlife.
The Kwando River in the Caprivi Strip is a vital waterway for wildlife, known for hippos and crocodiles.
The Zambezi River forms part of Namibia's northern border, an important water source and habitat.
The Erongo Mountains are an eroded volcano, known for unique rock formations and San rock art.
The Erongo Mountains are a ring-shaped volcanic complex with dramatic landscapes, important for climbing and hiking.
The Waterberg Plateau is a striking table mountain formation, known for its steep cliffs and rich wildlife.
The Tsau Khaeb Sperrgebiet is a vast diamond restricted area with pristine coastal landscapes and desert dunes.
The Huns Mountains in southern Namibia are an ancient mountain range, characterized by rugged beauty and diverse ecosystems.
The Naukluft Mountains are part of the Namib-Naukluft Park, known for its rugged terrain and natural springs.
The Muhlo Mountains are a remote mountain range in the Kunene region, home to unique flora and fauna.
The Otavi Mountains are a range in northern Namibia, known for their karst topography and caves.
The Zebra Mountains are a striking mountain range in the Namib Desert, characterized by their striped appearance.
The Baynes Mountains are a rugged range in the Kaokoveld, offering spectacular views and rare wildlife.
The Hartmann Mountains are a remote range in northern Kaokoveld, known for majestic desert landscapes.
The Grootberg Plateau is an impressive basalt formation in Damaraland, offering spectacular vistas.
